vulnerability.name: RUSTSEC-2023-0071
vulnerability.description: rsa crate "Marvin Attack": timing side channel in RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 decryption

statements.impact_statement: The Marvin Attack is an online chosen-ciphertext oracle: it needs a service that decrypts attacker-supplied RSA ciphertexts and leaks decryption timing back to the attacker. sipnab uses the rsa crate only under the optional `tls` feature, to decrypt offline the pre-master secret of an already-captured TLS 1.2 handshake with an operator-supplied key (`--tls-key`). No network-facing decryption oracle exists, nothing an attacker supplies is decrypted on demand, and no decryption timing is returned to anyone. No fixed rsa release exists as of 0.9.x. Re-evaluate if sipnab ever grows an online decryption path.

vulnerability.name: GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c
vulnerability.description: sprintf-js denial of service through unbounded precision specifiers in a format string

statements.impact_statement: sprintf-js is not part of sipnab: no binary, package or crate the project ships contains it. It appears only in e2e/package-lock.json, the dev tooling for the website's Lighthouse CI step (@lhci/cli -> @lhci/utils -> js-yaml 3 -> argparse 1 -> sprintf-js 1.0.3), where argparse formats its own help templates and no attacker-supplied text becomes a format string. osv.dev lists no fixed release (every version through 1.1.3 is affected). Re-evaluate when a fix is published or @lhci drops js-yaml 3.
